scientific_integrity: The all-dimensions statement follows from a direct algebraic proof; finite verification is diagnostic only. Previously known matching-shift condition bounds are credited. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Real symmetric positive semidefinite finite matrices with at least two distinct eigenvalues only.
Full-state observation, full control, Euclidean norms; no general nonnormal or partial-control result.
Spectral conditioning, not practical total preconditioned solve cost, is optimized.
The full earlier Pearson-Wathen matching paper was inaccessible; residual equivalence risk remains.
title: Spectrally optimal scalar feedback for fully observed quadratic control
